evals.prompt: Using requirements.md, design the relational schema for posts and tags and write it as a migration in db/, including foreign keys and indexes for the hot queries.
evals.expected_output: Relational integrity constraints and index configurations are specified.
expectations: A db/NNN_*.sql migration defines posts, tags, and a post_tags join table with primary and foreign keys
Foreign key actions match the requirements: deleting a post cascades to its links, deleting an in-use tag is restricted
Indexes cover the hot queries (tag to published posts by date, unique slug, case-insensitive unique tag name)
Column types and constraints are appropriate (status constrained to the three values, timestamps with time zone)
